notes.title: 🚀 Mars Calls – No Ticket Back: Launching Now with 10% OFF!
notes.content:
Prepare for the ultimate survival horror experience in deep space.
Your crew was bound for Mars — a hopeful mission to colonize the Red Planet. But something went terribly wrong. The SS McCalister’s Hope is no longer a ship... it’s a deathtrap haunted by nightmares, infected with terror, and crawling with the undead. There's no ticket back — only one chance to survive.

No Ticket Back blends horror, roguelike, tower defense, RPG, zombie survival, and colony sim into one relentless experience.
Scavenge. Build. Fight. Lead your crew. Make brutal decisions.
Every run is different. Every moment counts.

Will you escape? Or become part of the ship’s dark legend?

notes.title: GDWC 2024 Honors No Ticket Back: Craft, Survive & Escape with 3rd Best Web3 Game
notes.content:
As a lifelong fan of classic RTS and survival games, creating No Ticket Back has been an incredible journey. Seeing it place 3rd in the Best Web3 Game category at GDWC 2024 is beyond exciting for me and the entire team. We’ve poured our hearts into blending the nostalgia of the 90s-era gaming, with modern mechanics and blockchain technology to offer something truly unique.

The game’s story of survival, crafting, and escape in the unforgiving vastness of space was inspired by my love for high-stakes strategy and exploration. Every choice the player makes in No Ticket Back matters—whether it's crafting a tool or navigating through the terrifying unknown. It’s about immersing players in an atmosphere where survival feels personal, and every victory is hard-fought.

I want to thank everyone who has supported us throughout this journey, from our early fans to the judges at GDWC 2024. Your passion fuels our creativity. For those of you who haven't experienced No Ticket Back yet, there's still much more to come—this is only the beginning. Add us to your wishlist and get ready to embark on a survival adventure that will test your courage, strategy, and will to escape.

notes.title: 🚀 Ready for Space Exploration Fest? 🚀
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 Ready for Space Exploration Fest? 🚀[/h1]

[h3]No Ticket Back: Craft, Survive & Escape is joining the Steam Space Exploration Fest with a thrilling new update![/h3]

Step into the terrifying world of No Ticket Back, a unique blend of horror, roguelike strategy, and survival. This game combines elements of zombie survival, tower defense, RPG, crafting, building, and colony management to deliver a spine-chilling experience unlike any other.

[h3]🛸 Embark on a Harrowing Odyssey:[/h3]

The SS McCalister's Hope: Once a symbol of humanity’s aspirations for Mars, the SS McCalister's Hope now drifts through space as a haunted vessel. Its corridors echo with the moans of the undead and the whispers of a doomed crew.
Survive the Nightmare: With the ship overrun by a relentless zombie apocalypse, every decision could mean the difference between life and death. Manage resources, fortify your defenses, and craft weapons to fend off the undead.
Escape the Ghostly Ship: As the crew battles both physical and psychological horrors, the ultimate goal is to escape the clutches of this cursed vessel. But will they survive long enough to see another sunrise?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921072/66451281e6f272b3e56f12101516d112334fa206.png[/img]

[h3]🎮 Game Highlights:[/h3]

Roguelike Elements: Each playthrough is unique, with procedurally generated challenges that test your strategy and survival skills.
Crafting & Building: Gather resources, craft essential items, and build structures to improve your chances of survival.
Colony Management: Lead your crew, make tough decisions, and ensure the survival of as many members as possible.
Tower Defense Mechanics: Fortify your position and defend against waves of undead using strategically placed defenses.
Prepare for a journey filled with dread, strategy, and the fight for survival in space. Will you and your crew find a way to escape, or will the SS McCalister's Hope become your eternal tomb? 🚀👻

[h3]Stay tuned for more updates during the Space Exploration Fest![/h3]

notes.title: No Ticket Back - Endless Replayability
notes.content:
"No Ticket Back" offers endless replayability with multiple paths to explore and various outcomes depending on your choices. As you progress, you'll face moral dilemmas, unexpected betrayals, and dangerous creatures that are drawn to the chaos. Can you keep your crew together and make it to the Red Planet, or will you become another ghost story in the annals of space exploration?

Prepare for a thrilling, nerve-wracking experience as you and your crew struggle to survive. Welcome aboard, and good luck—you're going to need it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921072/db99d521c22befa00a53688619b566fb81a7d09c.png[/img]

🚀 Your Mission
What starts as a routine mission to Mars quickly turns into a fight for survival. Strange noises, inexplicable events, and a creeping sense of dread fill the corridors of your once-proud spacecraft. You and your crew must navigate these chilling challenges, solve intricate puzzles, and manage limited resources to stand a chance of reaching your destination.

Play demo today and enjoy Endless Replayability!
